289.speaker: Narrator
289.text:
Not long after your arrival, Lucita gave birth to your son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}.

For the second time, you were a father.

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: Long live the new prince of Rizia.

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: There wasn't much to complain about.

298.speaker: Narrator
298.text: Your new life of leisure took some getting used to. You were grateful that you could at least enjoy the same luxury you had back in Rizia.

302.speaker: Narrator
302.text:
The eight years you spent as a monarch faded in your memory, replaced by new adventures and challenges. 

You found yourself answering to "Duke Toras" just as easily as you once answered to "Your Majesty".

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: ...begged her to find a peaceful solution.

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: ...prayed for minimal casualties on both sides.

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: ...toasted to victory with the Rummish elite.

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: And it was fired at Holsord.

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text:
In the wake of Holsord's destruction, the superpowers started deploying their nuclear weapons as well.

Within a couple of hours, all hell broke loose in Thornborough.

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: Everything ended with a blinding light.

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: ...isolated yourself and waited for the war to end.

337.speaker: Narrator
337.text:
You isolated yourself in your mansion. When the Sordish Armed Forces entered the city, they started to unleash their vengeance on the Rummish nobility in the capital.

Before long, the soldiers broke down your door and pointed guns at your head. Ordered to arrest anyone connected to the Livingstons, they charged you with death.

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text:
On your last days, you planned an escape from Thornborough with your family.

However, you were caught at the city's borders by the Queen's soldiers. 

The punishment was clear.

339.speaker: Narrator
339.text:
On your last days, you joined the armed resistance in Thornborough and were deployed to fight against the incoming Sordish Armed Forces.

You charged at the invaders as a Sordish bullet flew straight towards your head.

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: ...assisted the Queen however you could while raising your son.
